evidence_quotes.agenda: "Before I proceed on confirming all the information you've entered online, I just like to ask if you have any concern about the moving process. Do you have any worries..." — asked before probing
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if ever that it's shorter or longer than this, then my estimate could either be less or more on the move day" / "if the move takes less than this you will only be charged for how much time we use"

top_strength: Clean, efficient logistics confirmation and a well-personalized estimate anchor (stairs on one end, elevator on the other, minimum-hours logic explained clearly).
coaching_note: Talked past the close question again ("would you like to be on the schedule today? No deposit is required") without pausing, and the call stayed fairly transactional throughout — no differentiator coverage and limited personal warmth beyond the script.
